issues.jp_before: 弟[おとうと]は玄関[げんかん]の前[まえ]で足[あし]を{止[と]めました|tr-hajimaru}。
issues.problem: The "why" said "He stops his own foot", which is a misleading literal reading of the idiom 足を止める (to stop walking).
issues.action: Rewrote why: 足を止める (to stop walking) has 足 as its を-object, so the transitive 止める is needed.
